record.paper_title: Recent developments and open problems in the theory of permanents
record.original_question: Let A=(a_ij) be an n x n positive semidefinite matrix, and let A(i,j) be the submatrix obtained by deleting row i and column j of A. Is per(A) the largest eigenvalue of the n x n matrix whose (i,j)-entry is a_ij per(A(i,j))?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A=(a_{ij})$ be an $n\times n$ positive semidefinite Hermitian matrix. For indices $1\le i,j\le n$, let $A(i,j)$ denote the $(n-1)\times(n-1)$ submatrix of $A$ obtained by deleting the $i$-th row and the $j$-th column. The permanent of an $m\times m$ matrix $M=(m_{kl})$ is defined by
$$\operatorname{per}(M)=\sum_{\sigma\in S_m}\prod_{k=1}^m m_{k,\sigma(k)}.$$
Define the $n\times n$ matrix $B=(b_{ij})$ by
$$b_{ij}=a_{ij}\,\operatorname{per}(A(i,j)).$$
Prove or disprove: for every $n\times n$ positive semidefinite Hermitian matrix $A$, the value $\operatorname{per}(A)$ is the largest eigenvalue of $B$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is one of the Bapat–Sunder conjectures on permanents of positive semidefinite matrices. Drury exhibited counterexamples to several closely related Bapat–Sunder conjectures (including the Hadamard-product version and the permanent-on-top conjecture). Surveys on permanent conjectures continue to list this eigenvalue-version conjecture, and recent work studies implications between such conjectures, suggesting the precise statement here has not been clearly settled in the available literature. Status is recorded as unknown.

status_evidence.title: A counterexample to a question of Bapat and Sunder (Drury)
status_evidence.snippet: Drury provides a counterexample to a Bapat-Sunder conjecture on permanents of positive semidefinite matrices.
status_evidence.claim: Drury has refuted at least one Bapat-Sunder conjecture about permanents of PSD matrices.

status_evidence.title: An update on a few permanent conjectures (Zhang)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of the status of various permanent conjectures including those of Bapat and Sunder.
status_evidence.claim: The eigenvalue formulation involving a_ij per(A(i,j)) is listed among permanent conjectures whose status is surveyed.

status_evidence.title: A logical implication between two conjectures on matrix permanents
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes implications among Bapat-Sunder type conjectures, indicating ongoing research on these questions.
status_evidence.claim: Bapat-Sunder type permanent conjectures remain active subjects of research.
